title_es: Homilía 20 sobre la Epístola a los Hebreos
title_en: Homily 20 on Hebrews (Homilies on the Epistle to the Hebrews)
date: c. 403 (Constantinople; date not verified in sources I read)
translator_edition: Frederic Gardiner, Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, vol. 14 (Buffalo: Christian Literature Publishing Co., 1889), revised for New Advent by Kevin Knight
original_edition: Frederick Field (ed.), Ioannis Chrysostomi Homiliae in Epistolam ad Hebraeos, Oxford (1862), vol. VII; OCR text on archive.org (chrysostom_pauline_homilies_field_vol_7). PG 63 column: not determined.
authenticity_note: genuine (no dispute raised in sources read); the transmitted Hebrews homilies are records of preached sermons; the brief names Constantine of Antioch as their editor (not verified by me)
notes: New Advent page read in full. Gardiner's Hom. 20 covers Heb 10:26-31 in its sections 1-4; sections 5-7 are exhortation. Gardiner's Hom. 19 covers Heb 10:19-25, not 10:26-31 as the brief suggested. Scripture markers in the New Advent text were stripped from the quotations.
